$comment: What every setting in this section does, its type and allowed values; defaults are in config.json beside this file. See scripts/pipeline/lib/settings.mjs.

prCheck.timeoutSec.does: The normal time a PR check critic, defender or judge may take.

prCheck.fixTimeoutSec.does: The normal time one run of the PR check's fixer may take.

prCheck.maxDiffChars.does: The most characters of a PR's diff the critics read.

prCheck.hook.enabled.does: Runs the automatic PR check when the implementer finishes.

prCheck.hook.requireTests.does: Makes the automatic PR check wait until the tests are verified.

prCheck.hook.pollSec.does: How often the automatic PR check looks whether the tests are verified.

prCheck.exclude.does: Paths the PR check leaves out of the diff.

prCheck.conventions.does: Documents the style critic checks the PR against.

prCheck.infraPaths.does: Changes to shared test setup, build and CI files the harness lists whatever the critics say (regular expressions).

prCheck.video.extensions.does: File extensions the PR check reads as videos.

prCheck.video.defaultDirs.does: Folders the PR check looks for videos in.

prCheck.video.maxFrames.does: The most still frames the PR check looks at per video.

prCheck.video.maxTotalFrames.does: The most frames across all of a PR's videos.

prCheck.video.minFramesPerVideo.does: The fewest frames taken from each video, whatever the total.

prCheck.video.minIntervalSec.does: The shortest time between two frames of a video without narrated steps.

prCheck.video.width.does: The width frames are scaled to.

prCheck.video.framesPerStep.does: How many frames the PR check takes from each step of a narrated video.

prCheck.returnToImplementation.maxReturn.does: How many times a PR check failure can send the code back to the implementer before a person decides.

prCheck.maxDebateTurns.does: How many times the PR check's critics and defender answer each other in each round before the judge rules.

prCheck.fixMinSeverity.does: The least serious PR check finding that is fixed before a feature's PR opens; less serious ones are only listed.

prCheck.returnToImplementation.minSeveri.does: The least serious PR check finding about the production code that goes back to the implementer; less serious ones go to the PR check's own fixer.

prCheck.returnToImplementation.implement.does: The PR check lenses whose findings are about the production code.

prCheck.returnToImplementation.lightLens.does: The PR check lenses whose findings stay with the light fixer when they name no production file.

prCheck.returnToImplementation.lightPath.does: Files that are only tests, docs or pipeline records: a finding about them alone stays with the light fixer.

prCheck.hook.waitForTestsSec.does: How long the automatic PR check waits for the tests to be verified before it gives up.

prCheck.mode.does: What the PR check does before a ticket's or an epic's PR opens: fix what it finds, only report, or not run.

prCheck.returnToImplementation.enabled.does: Sends PR check findings about the production code back to the implementer.

prCheck.fixLenses.does: Kinds of PR check findings that are always fixed, whatever their severity.

prCheck.maxCouncilRounds.does: How many rounds the PR check gets, in delivery, in an epic, in a CI fix and by hand (`--max-rounds` overrides it for a run by hand), before it escalates.

prCheck.councilPassScore.does: The score every blocking member of the PR check council must give, with no blocking finding standing, for it to pass (any council size).

prCheck.councilMembers.does: How many counted members sit on the PR check council, beside the fixed clean-code seat (`null`: `council.members`).

prCheck.orchestrator.model.does: The `models.pool` entry the PR check orchestrator runs on (`null`: `orchestrator.model`).

prCheck.orchestrator.effort.does: The PR check orchestrator's reasoning effort (`null`: `orchestrator.effort`, else its entry's).

prCheck.councilIntercom.does: The PR check council's own discussion settings, over `council.intercom` (a council of one holds no discussion).
